name: OpenRe.Stream

exposure.note: the domain serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder page

site.name: OpenRe.Stream
site.what: Ingest once and send the stream to every platform at once; keys, destinations and output health in one place.

notes: Ingest and restream authority (ADR-009). Alpha: RTMP ingest and RTMP/SRT restream run in transport workers with generations and leases, separate from the API; WHIP, WebRTC/SFU and JSMPEG are still ingested by Live. Runs in parallel with Live; slots move one at a time behind Live's per-slot ingest_authority switch.
